§05 One-Call Technical Brief: Expiry Is Not Fencing

The Five-Role Overlapping Handle Exchange [Part 2/4]: Subtopics: Role G: the long-term exclusion; Role W: pin and hash the preimage; Role P: pin the parent directory; Role T: stage and rename the new object; Role H: bridge publication to the next guard; Role G': verify before success — Windows refuses to rename over an existing destination when any open handle withholds FILE_SHARE_DELETE. The long-term guard therefore cannot simply remain open across replacement.   • The Clock Is Not the Fence [Part 4/4]: A lease expires because coordination needs a way forward. That does not mean the old worker has become harmless. Authority must change form at the resource: a new generation, a new holder, a new epoch, and a kernel-enforced exclusion that survives the replacement.
